scope: The Hotel Nacional de Cuba in Havana as photographed in October 2007. Includes the main hotel ranges, twin towers and their corner turrets, connected entrance projection and attached low northwestern wing. The gardens, detached structures, vehicles and interiors are outside the model.

originalReview.notes: October 2007 view establishes the long cream landward elevation, two main wings, regular window rows, tower crown and dark recessed forecourt.

references.filename: Hotel Nacional de Cuba La Habana.jpg

originalReview.notes: January 2006 oblique shows the seaward-side wing and terrace, tall open tower, smaller surrounding turrets and its low red roof.

quallaSearch.notes: Two exact published Qualla originals are own-work photographs with explicit public-domain dedications. The January 2006 oblique corroborates the October 2007 architectural appearance.
